The legal profession is one of the growing and lucrative professions all over the world. It is one of the most adventurous as well as an exciting career. Lawyers are held in high esteem in our society, and there remains the faith that when all else fails, one can still take recourse to the legal system. In our daily life in one way or other, we may come across situations where legal advice is required. In such a situation, we need the advice of legal professionals, who analyze and interpret law properly. There are a lot of opportunities for law graduates after graduation. They can get opportunities in various legal professions like the judiciary, civil services and legal advisors and may also practice law in the courts that are quite awarding. The young lawyers can also find attractive positions in International organizations. There are various areas of specialization in this field, which one can choose from; like corporation law, civil law, criminal law, international law, labour law, patent law, tax law and so on.
Chairman, Law Department.
Abdul Wali Khan University,
Mardan.
